links.outcome: NIHSS scoring mean absolute error under context stress (document length, distractor load, critical-information position)
links.effect: MAE 4.58 to 2.96 points; mean gain 1.62 MAE points (95% CI 1.57–1.67); 35% relative reduction; consistent gains across all 36 stress combinations; larger gains in lower-cost models (2.76 vs 0.45 MAE points)
links.quote: Structured retrieval reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 4.58 to 2.96 points relative to non-agentic baselines (mean gain 1.62 MAE points; 95% CI 1.57–1.67; 35% relative reduction), with consistent gains across all 36 stress combinations.

design_hint: structured retrieval grounding under context stress
